units.source_text: “用了那么多时间吗？”名人出乎意外，露出了呆滞的神色。

en.t: "Did I really use that much time?" The Master looked surprised and showed a vacant expression.

units.source_text: 这天，名人十一手所用的时间加起来，

en.t: That day, when the time the Master had used for his eleven moves was added together,

units.source_text: 比对手七段的黑59一手所用的一小时三十五分还少了十六分钟。

en.t: it was still sixteen minutes less than the one hour and thirty-five minutes his opponent, the seventh-dan player, had spent on the single move Black 59.

units.source_text: 可是名人却好像觉得自己下得比少女的记录更快一些。

en.t: Yet the Master seemed to feel that he had played somewhat faster than the girl's record.
